inputs: durable public tool and model-response metadata
existing cumulative split-token and model-call limits
public task constraints and tracked UTF-8 source
failure_modes: insufficient exact input, output, total-token or model-call capacity fails before redispatch
a second actionless or reasoning-only incomplete response is terminal
untrusted, missing, non-UTF-8 or out-of-scope source produces guidance without a source excerpt
edit correction never synthesizes or applies a mutation
legacy V6 bytes and behavior remain unchanged
acceptance_cases: after a successful mutation, an exploratory request exposes only the next completion action
a first current-diff check is forced before further investigation
a failed current-diff check exposes correction only and a successful correction forces recheck
passing checks force diff review and then structured submission
one fundable actionless primary response receives one low-effort action-only retry
actionless and reasoning-only incomplete responses share one run-global retry slot
an unfundable or already-consumed retry stops without another provider dispatch
raw and structured edit rejections return bounded typed correction evidence without mutation
V6 request evidence and runtime selection are regression-tested unchanged
offline qualification performs zero provider, Docker and evaluator calls
